text:
mira: Quick sync: ops proposing a sweep to bump `prefix_cache_ttl` 30->300. Want minimal UX + rollback plan before we run.

alex: Risk is increased per-shard memory. Need mem delta and p99 impact.

jess: Console request: mark sweep entries specially (different badge) and surface per-tenant cache delta. Can add optional `rollout_type` meta in apply API.

sam: Rollout idea: staging replay 24h, 1% tenant cohort 2h, 10% 6h, full sweep. Gates: min samples + mem delta <5% + p99 <10ms. Warm window 30m before evaluating.

ops-bot: Alert created: `prefix-cache-mem-80pct` (ACL-3742).

mira: Decision: use `config_version` bump for atomic apply and keep prior version cached 10m for quick revert. jess to draft API opt-ins for UI. sam to post staging numbers EOD.

jess: Will prototype panel showing per-tenant mem delta (aggregated if needed).

alex: OK to proceed if staging looks good.

mira: Thanks — ping here with any blockers. :thumbsup:
